nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic and set once in the DAEXToken constructor.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by transfer and the DAEXToken constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; written by approve and read by allowance.
Constant token name string "DAEX Token".
Constant token symbol string "DAX".
Constant decimals value 18.
Public address holding the initial token allocation, set in the constructor.
Interface declaration of balanceOf(address) in ERC20Basic; no implementation.
Interface declaration of transfer(address,uint256) in ERC20Basic; no implementation.
Interface declaration of allowance(address,address) in ERC20Basic; no implementation.
Interface declaration of approve(address,uint256) in ERC20Basic; no implementation.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to; performs unchecked uint256 subtraction and addition on the balances mapping.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value after requiring the current allowance to be zero or the new value to be zero.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor that sets target, mints totalSupply = 2*10**27 and credits the whole supply to target.
Caller-controlled address used as the source of funds in transfer and as the owner key in approve/allowance.
State-mutating arithmetic statement balances[msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath (Solidity 0.4.17).
State-mutating arithmetic statement balances[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath; overflow possible.
State-mutating assignment allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value guarded only by a zero-allowance require.
Arithmetic expression 2*10**27 used to derive totalSupply and the initial balance credited to target.
Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transfer.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transfer, applied to both balance updates.
Address parameter whose balance is queried.
Spender address parameter granted the allowance.
Allowance amount parameter stored in the allowed mapping.
Owner address parameter used as the first index of the allowed mapping.
Spender address parameter used as the second index of the allowed mapping.
Constructor parameter receiving the initial supply and stored in the target state variable.
Named return value (bool) of StandardToken.transfer.
Named return value (uint256) of StandardToken.balanceOf.
Named return value (uint256) of StandardToken.allowance.
Named return value (bool) of StandardToken.approve.
